mapper.select: SELECT gso.od_id,gso.od_time,gso.od_b_name,gso.od_b_tel,CONCAT('(', gso.od_b_zip1, gso.od_b_zip2, ') ', gso.od_b_addr1, ', ', gso.od_b_addr2, ' ', gso.od_b_addr3) AS od_address,gso.od_memo,gso.od_settle_case,gso.od_shop_memo,gso.od_invoice,gso.od_bank_account,gso.od_deposit_name,gso.od_app_no,gso.od_cart_price, (gso.od_send_cost + gso.od_send_cost2) AS total_od_send_cost, gso.od_send_cost,gso.od_send_cost2, gso.od_cart_coupon,gso.od_receipt_point,gso.od_receipt_price,gso.od_misu,gso.od_send_coupon, (SELECT SUM(gsc.ct_point * gsc.ct_qty) FROM g5_shop_cart gsc WHERE mb_id = gso.mb_id AND od_id = gso.od_id) AS total_expect_save_point, ( SELECT SUM((si.it_cust_price - si.it_price) * sc.ct_qty) FROM g5_shop_cart sc INNER JOIN g5_shop_item si ON sc.it_id = si.it_id WHERE sc.io_type = 0 AND sc.od_id = gso.od_id ) AS total_discount_price, gso.od_cancel_price, gso.od_status, gso.od_b_zip1, gso.od_b_zip2,gso.od_b_addr1,gso.od_b_addr2,gso.od_b_addr3,gso.od_addr_jibeon, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.io_type = 0 THEN (si.it_cust_price + sc.io_price) * sc.ct_qty ELSE io_price * sc.ct_qty END), 0) FROM g5_shop_cart sc INNER JOIN g5_shop_item si ON sc.it_id = si.it_id WHERE sc.od_id = gso.od_id ) AS total_original_price, pcc.code_nm AS od_delivery_company, gso.od_delivery_company AS delivery_company_code, gso.od_coupon, gso.subscribe_amount, gso.subscribe_count, 0 AS total_refund_price, (SELECT ct_status FROM g5_shop_cart WHERE od_id = gso.od_id LIMIT 1) AS ct_status, gso.od_completion_date FROM g5_shop_order gso LEFT JOIN pet_common_code pcc ON gso.od_delivery_company = pcc.code_cd WHERE gso.od_id = #{odId} AND gso.mb_id = #{mbId};

SELECT gso.od_id,gso.od_time,gsc.ct_id,gsc.it_name,gsc.it_id, gso.od_cart_count,gsc.ct_price,CASE WHEN gsc.ct_status = '반품' OR gsc.ct_status = '반품접수' OR gsc.ct_status = '반품완료' OR gsc.ct_status = '반품정산완료' THEN gsc.ct_status ELSE gso.od_status END AS od_status, gsc.pet_id,gsc.ct_option, gsc.ct_qty, CASE WHEN gsi.it_img1 != '' THEN gsi.it_img1 ELSE NULL END AS product_img_url, gsc.pet_history_id, gsc.urine_check_history_id, IFNULL((SELECT io_price FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE io_id = gsc.io_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS io_price, IFNULL((SELECT io_type FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE io_id = gsc.io_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS io_type,'택배배송' AS od_delivery_method, CASE WHEN gsi.it_point_type = 1 THEN COALESCE(ROUND((gsi.it_price * (gsi.it_point / 100) / 10) * 10), 0) ELSE 0 END AS expect_save_point, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsc.it_id AND od_id = gsc.od_id AND gsc.ct_status = '완료' AND del_fl = 0 ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS review_fl, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsc.it_id AND od_id = gsc.od_id AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(gsc.ct_history, '|', -2), '|', 1), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 15 DAY) AND gsc.ct_status = '완료' AND del_fl = 0 ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS review_del_fl, gsc.ct_status, gso.od_completion_date, gsc.refund_invoice, gsc.refund_company, gso.subscribe_amount, gso.subscribe_count FROM g5_shop_order gso INNER JOIN g5_shop_cart gsc ON gso.od_id = gsc.od_id INNER JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsc.it_id = gsi.it_id WHERE gso.od_id = #{odId} AND gso.mb_id = #{mbId};

SELECT gso.od_id,gso.od_time,gso.od_b_name,gso.od_b_tel,CONCAT('(', gso.od_b_zip1, gso.od_b_zip2, ') ', gso.od_b_addr1, ', ', gso.od_b_addr2, ' ', gso.od_b_addr3) AS od_address,gso.od_memo,gso.od_settle_case,gso.od_shop_memo,gso.od_invoice,gso.od_bank_account,gso.od_deposit_name,gso.od_app_no,gso.od_cart_price, (gso.od_send_cost + gso.od_send_cost2) AS total_od_send_cost, gso.od_send_cost,gso.od_send_cost2 ,gso.od_cart_coupon,gso.od_receipt_point,gso.od_receipt_price,gso.od_misu,gso.od_send_coupon, (gsc.ct_point * gsc.ct_qty) AS total_expect_save_point, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.it_cust_price), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(si.it_price), 0) FROM g5_shop_cart sc INNER JOIN g5_shop_item si ON sc.it_id = si.it_id WHERE sc.ct_id = gsc.ct_id ) AS total_discount_price, gso.od_cancel_price, gso.od_status, gso.od_b_zip1, gso.od_b_zip2,gso.od_b_addr1,gso.od_b_addr2,gso.od_b_addr3,gso.od_addr_jibeon, ( gso.od_cart_price + ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.it_cust_price), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(si.it_price), 0) FROM g5_shop_cart sc INNER JOIN g5_shop_item si ON sc.it_id = si.it_id WHERE sc.ct_id = gsc.ct_id ) ) AS total_original_price, pcc.code_nm AS od_delivery_company, gso.od_delivery_company AS delivery_company_code, gso.od_coupon, COALESCE((SELECT (subGsc.ct_price * subGsc.ct_qty) FROM g5_shop_order gso INNER JOIN g5_shop_cart subGsc ON gso.od_id = subGsc.od_id WHERE subGsc.ct_id = gsc.ct_id GROUP BY gso.od_receipt_point) , 0) AS total_refund_price, gso.subscribe_amount, gso.subscribe_count, gso.od_completion_date, gso.refund_bank, gso.refund_deposit, gso.refund_bank_account FROM g5_shop_order gso INNER JOIN g5_shop_cart gsc ON gso.od_id = gsc.od_id LEFT JOIN pet_common_code pcc ON gso.od_delivery_company = pcc.code_cd WHERE gso.od_id = #{odId} AND gso.mb_id = #{mbId} AND gsc.ct_id = #{ctId};

SELECT id, od_id, ct_id, price, point, product_back_status, product_back_name, product_back_cd, product_trouble_cd, withdraw_date, withdraw_request_cd, withdraw_request_etc, phone, tel, zip1, zip2, addr1, addr2, addr3, create_ymd FROM pet_product_back WHERE od_id = #{odId} AND ct_id = #{ctId}

SELECT gso.od_id,gso.od_time,gsc.ct_id,gsc.it_name,gsc.it_id, gso.od_cart_count,gsc.ct_price,CASE WHEN gsc.ct_status = '반품' OR gsc.ct_status = '반품접수' OR gsc.ct_status = '반품완료' OR gsc.ct_status = '반품정산완료' THEN gsc.ct_status ELSE gso.od_status END AS od_status, gsc.pet_id,gsc.ct_option, gsc.ct_qty, CASE WHEN gsi.it_img1 != '' THEN gsi.it_img1 ELSE NULL END AS product_img_url, gsc.pet_history_id, gsc.urine_check_history_id, IFNULL((SELECT io_price FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE io_id = gsc.io_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS io_price, IFNULL((SELECT io_type FROM g5_shop_item_option WHERE io_id = gsc.io_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS io_type,'택배배송' AS od_delivery_method, CASE WHEN gsi.it_point_type = 1 THEN COALESCE(ROUND((gsi.it_price * (gsi.it_point / 100) / 10) * 10), 0) ELSE 0 END AS expect_save_point, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsc.it_id AND od_id = gsc.od_id AND gsc.ct_status = '완료' AND del_fl = 0 ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS review_fl, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE it_id = gsc.it_id AND od_id = gsc.od_id AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(gsc.ct_history, '|', -2), '|', 1), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 15 DAY) AND gsc.ct_status = '완료' AND del_fl = 0 ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS review_del_fl, gsc.ct_status, gsc.refund_invoice, gsc.refund_company FROM g5_shop_order gso INNER JOIN g5_shop_cart gsc ON gso.od_id = gsc.od_id INNER JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsc.it_id = gsi.it_id WHERE gso.od_id = #{odId} AND gso.mb_id = #{mbId} AND gsc.ct_id = #{ctId};
SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS total_cnt;

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(point_point), 0) AS total_point FROM ( SELECT SUM(gsc.ct_point * gsc.ct_qty) AS point_point FROM g5_shop_cart gsc JOIN g5_shop_order gso ON gsc.od_id = gso.od_id WHERE gso.mb_id = #{mbId} AND gso.od_status IN ('주문', '입금', '준비', '배송')
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(ROUND(CAST(gsi.it_price AS DECIMAL(20,4)) * (CAST(gsi.it_2 AS DECIMAL(5,2)) / 100) / 10 * 10)) AS point_point FROM g5_shop_cart gsc JOIN g5_shop_order gso ON gsc.od_id = gso.od_id JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsc.it_id = gsi.it_id WHERE gso.mb_id = #{mbId} AND gso.od_status IN ('완료') AND gsi.it_2 IS NOT NULL AND gsi.it_2 != 0 AND gsc.it_id NOT IN (SELECT it_id FROM g5_shop_item_use WHERE mb_id = gsc.mb_id AND del_fl = 0 GROUP BY it_id) ) AS sub

SELECT po_id, po_datetime, po_content, po_point AS savePoint, po_expired, po_expire_date FROM g5_point gsc WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND po_expired = 0 AND po_expire_date != '9999-12-31' ORDER BY po_expire_date ASC limit 1

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gsc.cp_no DESC) AS row_num, gsc.cp_id, gsc.cp_subject, gsc.cp_method, gsc.cp_target, gsc.cp_start, gsc.cp_end, gsc.cp_type, gsc.cp_price, gsc.cp_minimum, gsc.cz_id, gsi.it_name FROM g5_shop_coupon gsc LEFT JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsi.it_id = gsc.cp_target WHERE gsc.mb_id IN ( #{mbId}, '전체회원' ) AND gsc.cp_start <= CURDATE() AND gsc.cp_end >= CURDATE() AND not EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM g5_shop_coupon_log gscl WHERE gscl.cp_id = gsc.cp_id ) LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS total_cnt;

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cz_id DESC) AS row_num, gsc.cz_id, gsc.cz_subject, gsc.cz_period, gsc.cp_method, gsc.cp_target, gsc.cz_start, gsc.cz_end, gsc.cp_type, gsc.cp_price, gsc.cp_trunc, gsc.cp_minimum, gsc.cp_maximum, gsi.it_name FROM g5_shop_coupon_zone gsc LEFT JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsi.it_id = gsc.cp_target WHERE gsc.cz_id NOT IN ( SELECT gscz.cz_id from g5_shop_coupon_zone gscz JOIN g5_shop_coupon gso ON gscz.cz_id = gso.cz_id WHERE gso.mb_id = #{mbId}) AND cz_type = '0' AND cz_start <= CURDATE() AND gsc.cz_end >= CURDATE() LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS total_cnt;
SELECT cz_id, cz_subject, cz_period, cp_method, cp_target, cz_start, cz_end, cp_type, cp_price, cp_trunc, cp_minimum, cp_maximum FROM g5_shop_coupon_zone WHERE cz_id = #{czId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g5_shop_coupon(cp_id, cp_subject, cp_method, cp_target, mb_id, cz_id, cp_start, cp_end, cp_type, cp_price, cp_trunc, cp_minimum, cp_maximum, cp_datetime, od_id) SELECT #{cpId}, cz_subject, cp_method, cp_target, #{mbId}, cz_id, CURRENT_DATE, #{czEnd}, cp_type, cp_price, cp_trunc, cp_minimum, cp_maximum, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 FROM g5_shop_coupon_zone WHERE cz_id = #{czId} AND cz_id NOT IN (SELECT cz_id FROM g5_shop_coupon WHERE mb_id = #{mbId});
mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS total_cnt;
mapper.update: UPDATE g5_shop_item_use SET file_1 = NULL, file_2 = NULL, file_3 = NULL, file_4 = NULL, file_5 = NULL, file_6 = NULL, file_7 = NULL, file_8 = NULL WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND is_id = #{isId};

UPDATE g5_shop_item_use SET it_id = #{itId}, mb_id = #{mbId}, od_id = #{odId}, pet_id = #{petId}, is_name = #{isName}, is_score = #{isScore}, is_subject = #{isSubject}, is_content = #{isContent}, is_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_ip = #{isIp}, file_1 = #{file1}, file_2 = #{file2}, file_3 = #{file3}, file_4 = #{file4}, file_5 = #{file5}, file_6 = #{file6}, file_7 = #{file7}, file_8 = #{file8} WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND is_id = #{isId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g5_point ( mb_id, po_datetime, po_content, po_point, po_use_point, po_expired, po_expire_date, po_mb_point, po_rel_table, po_rel_id, po_rel_action ) SELECT gsc.mb_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONCAT('상품 ', gsc.it_id, ' (', #{isId}, ') 리뷰적립') AS po_content, CASE WHEN gsi.it_2 IS NOT NULL AND gsi.it_2 != '' THEN FLOOR((gsi.it_price * ((gsi.it_2) / 100) / 10 ) * 10) ELSE 0 END AS po_point, 0, 0, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (SELECT cf_point_term - 1 FROM g5_config LIMIT 1) DAY), #{poMbPoint}, '@review', 'admin', CONCAT(#{isId}, ',', gsc.it_id) AS po_rel_action FROM g5_shop_cart gsc INNER JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsi.it_id = gsc.it_id INNER JOIN g5_member gm ON gsc.mb_id = gm.mb_id WHERE gsc.od_id = #{odId} AND gsc.mb_id = #{mbId} GROUP BY gsc.od_id, gsc.it_id;
mapper.select: SELECT cf_point_term FROM g5_config

SELECT ( gm.mb_point + CASE WHEN gsi.it_2 IS NOT NULL AND gsi.it_2 != '' THEN FLOOR((gsi.it_price * ((gsi.it_2) / 100) / 10 ) * 10) ELSE 0 END ) AS po_mb_point FROM g5_shop_cart gsc INNER JOIN g5_shop_item gsi ON gsi.it_id = gsc.it_id INNER JOIN g5_member gm ON gsc.mb_id = gm.mb_id WHERE gsc.od_id = #{odId} GROUP BY od_id;
SELECT qa_category FROM g5_qa_config ORDER BY qa_category DESC limit 1

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gsiq.iq_time DESC) AS row_num, gsiq.iq_id, gsiq.it_id, gsiq.mb_id, gsiq.iq_secret, gsiq.iq_name, gsiq.iq_password, gsiq.iq_subject,
REGEXP_REPLACE(gsiq.iq_question, '<[^>]*>', '') AS iq_question, REGEXP_REPLACE(gsiq.iq_answer, '<[^>]*>', '') AS iq_answer , gsiq.iq_time, gsiq.iq_ip, (SELECT mb_nick FROM g5_member WHERE mb_id = gsiq.mb_id LIMIT 1) AS iq_nick FROM g5_shop_item_qa gsiq WHERE gsiq.mb_id = #{mbId} LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS total_cnt;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g5_shop_item_qa(it_id, mb_id, iq_secret, iq_name, iq_password, iq_subject, iq_question, iq_answer, iq_time, iq_ip) VALUES (#{itId}, #{mbId}, #{iqSecret}, #{iqName}, '', #{iqSubject}, #{iqQuestion}, '', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{iqIp})
mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS total_cnt;
SELECT qa_id, mb_id, qa_name, qa_type, qa_category, qa_subject, qa_content, qa_status, qa_file1 AS file_url, qa_source1 AS file_name, qa_datetime FROM g5_qa_content WHERE qa_id = #{qaId}
SELECT qa_id, mb_id, qa_name, qa_type, qa_category, qa_subject, qa_content, qa_status, qa_file1, qa_datetime FROM g5_qa_content WHERE qa_id != #{qaId} AND qa_related = #{qaId}
